items.topic: public racecard competition_score vs regulatory scoring
items.what_is_known: Current KEIRIN.JP racecard guide says displayed competition score is based on recent four months. JKA business rules define per-race competition points, average competition score and evaluation score, but an explicit current document mapping the public displayed rolling value to that regulatory calculation/update contract was not isolated.
items.next_source_action: Locate explicit public-score calculation/update documentation or keep provenance as public recent-four-month strength score only.
